Choose a practical booking note

The enquiry note covers the first description. The work-order note records assessable tasks and approval limits. The access note keeps the visit arrangements current and private. For fault-specific explanations, use the insights guides instead; these company notes do not replace a technical inspection.

  • Prepare the initial maintenance enquiry
  • Define the work-order scope
  • Keep repair access information together
Which note should a property manager start with?

Start with the enquiry note when the fault is first reported. Use the work-order note when turning that report into an instruction, then the access note to confirm how the agreed visit will take place.
